TOKENIZER-2.COA.SeedHint: The same seed always rolls the same arms. Leave it blank for a new roll each time.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.ShareAlikeNotice: This coat of arms uses a share-alike picture, so a picture made with it (a download, a token layer, a sheet's coat of arms) is shared under the same licence, crediting its author:
TOKENIZER-2.COA.ChargeStylePaintedHint: Flat paint with the picture's own lines, and no edge round plain shapes.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.ChargeStyleOutlinedHint: Flat paint inside a heavy dark outline.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.ChargeStyleSilhouetteHin: Filled with the charge's colour and no lines at all.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.ChargeStyleLineHint: The outline and lines in the charge's colour, the field showing through.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.DividedHalves: This shield is divided into two coats; edit each below, or roll again for a simpler one.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.RuleHeads: Beasts may show only their head
TOKENIZER-2.COA.RuleExtra: A chance of an extra charge
TOKENIZER-2.COA.RuleSwap: Ordinaries may swap paint with a patterned field
TOKENIZER-2.COA.LayerAdded: Coat of arms added as a layer.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.LoadFailed: Tokenizer 2: the coat of arms picture was stored but could not be loaded.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.Editing: Editing the coat of arms layer "{name}".
TOKENIZER-2.COA.SaveToSheetHint: Writes the picture to the character's Coat of Arms and the blazon to Heraldry.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.SaveFailed: The coat of arms could not be saved.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.ImportFailed: That file is not a coat of arms.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.Hint: Roll a coat of arms as the Pendragon rulebook does, change anything you like, then add it to the token.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.SheetTooltip: Click to design a coat of arms; Shift+click to choose a file.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.Settings.FolderHint: Where rendered coats of arms are saved, under Tokenizer 2's upload folder.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.Settings.SheetClickHint: Clicking the coat of arms on a Pendragon character or NPC sheet opens the generator (Shift+click still picks a file).
TOKENIZER-2.COA.Settings.DamaskHint: The faint pattern new coats of arms start with over their paint: scrolls, a lattice, a brocade, or none. Each coat keeps its own, changed on the Shield tab.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.Settings.ChargeStyleHint: The style new coats of arms start with; each coat keeps its own, changed on the Charges tab.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.Settings.ExportSizeHint: Pixels across the rendered coat of arms.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.PanelHint: Roll and edit the arms in the Coat of Arms window; Add to Token puts them on the token as a layer.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.FurHint: A fur has its own colours. Pick a plain field or a pattern to choose tinctures.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.SendToGMHint: Sends these arms to your GM, who approves them and puts them on the sheet.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.SentToGM: Sent to the GM for approval.
TOKENIZER-2.COA.SentToGMReplaced: Sent to the GM for approval, in place of your earlier request.
